name: InsertColumnToExcelWorksheet
label: Insert Column to Excel Worksheet
description: Inserts a new column to the left of the specified column in the provided Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object where the new column will be inserted.

fields.name: ColumnReference
fields.label: Column Reference
fields.description: The 1-based index or letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') of the column where the new column should be inserted.
